objective: Exercise the Phase 0 harness deterministically and emit a schema-valid experiment result without calling external services.

context.summary: This fixture tests the IDKMesh contracts and harness mechanics only; its smoke_score is not research evidence.

outputs.description: A deterministic, schema-valid smoke result generated by the local harness.

policies: Do not interpret smoke_score as scientific performance

uncertainty.statement: The v0.2 Work Unit fields remain an experimental hypothesis and may be simplified after real runner evidence.
uncertainty.resolution_strategy: Collect friction and interoperability evidence from issues #15 and #17 before the next breaking revision.

security.notes: The built-in smoke runner executes no manifest-supplied commands or external tools.

verification_policy.acceptance_rule: All required schema and reproduction validators must pass; worker self-report is never acceptance evidence.

validators.description: The same manifest, configuration, and seed produce the same smoke_score.

evidence_requirements.description: Record the canonical manifest SHA-256 digest.
